AI Notes.value: Independent British graphic designer and art director (Nash Projects), 10+ yrs experience. Educated at Nottingham Trent University (First Class Honours). Early career: North Kingdom (Stockholm), then Amore (Stockholm brand/packaging studio, now closed). Has operated Nash Projects independently since. Works across branding, identity, packaging, print, and art direction. Clients include HEAD Padel, A Day's March, T.H. Agyei, Big Drew's Small Batch, Annat, Late Nine, Arc Simulations, Synaptis. Confirmed freelance via site + Behance. Senior / mid-director level, solo operator; Autonomy 4. Work capture (re-scraped 2026-06-20 after Jonathan judged the prior set unrepresentative): nash-projects.com runs on Cargo.site which blocks headless image loading, so images were pulled full-res by parsing the Cargo media manifest and hitting the freight.cargo.site CDN directly. New selection spans 5 named projects (T.H. Agyei, HEAD Padel, Big Drew's Small Batch, Annat, Late Nine, plus a self-initiated boxing poster series); the off-capability WeTransfer/Outernet environmental work and sports photography were removed. Instagram @nashprojects_archive is currently unavailable (profile removed or set private); handle retained as his but not publicly viewable, no IG context shot possible.
